none: PAS FindID 984571: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17, on a small worn reddish flan. Obverse description: Bust left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS ROMA]. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins. Diameter: 13.4mm, Weight: 0.73gms, die axis: 6
